titleZh: 高考英语写作原创练习包（生成草稿）
author: 内置生成器草稿

sources.title: 本工具生成的基础练习
sources.rightsNote: 由项目内置生成器编写的原创练习句与题目，非真题转载；逐题独立审核进行中。

items.promptZh: 假定你是李华，你班每周五下午在教室举办英语角（English Corner）。请给外教 Mr. Smith 写一封邮件，邀请他参加本周的英语角，内容包括：(1)活动的时间和地点；(2)同学们主要讨论的内容；(3)表达期待。注意：写作词数应为 80-120 词，请按题目格式作答。

explanation.summaryZh: 邀请信要交代活动时间地点、说明活动内容并礼貌表达期待。
explanation.ruleZh: 应用文写作先覆盖全部要点，再按称呼—目的—细节—期待—落款组织语言。

requirementsZh: 使用邮件格式，包含称呼与落款
写清英语角的时间与地点
说明本次讨论的话题并表达期待
openingSentences: I'm writing to invite you to our English Corner this Friday afternoon.
checklistZh: 格式完整（称呼、正文、落款）
items.modelAnswer:
Dear Mr. Smith,

I'm writing to invite you to our English Corner this Friday afternoon. It will be held in Classroom 302 from 4:30 to 5:30, right after the last class.

Every week, students choose one hot topic and talk about it in small groups. This Friday we plan to discuss how to spend a meaningful summer holiday. Your stories about British schools would make our talks much livelier, and many of us hope to improve our spoken English with your help.

We would feel honored if you could come.

Yours,
Li Hua

items.promptZh: 假定你是李华，你校将于下月举办国际文化节（International Culture Festival），学生会正在招募志愿者。请给负责老师 Ms. Brown 写一封申请邮件，内容包括：(1)申请成为志愿者；(2)你的优势；(3)你希望承担的工作。注意：写作词数应为 80-120 词，请按题目格式作答。

explanation.summaryZh: 申请信要点明申请意向、列举自身优势并提出希望承担的工作。
explanation.ruleZh: 申请信用 First、Second 等序数词分层列举优势，结尾请求回复，层次清晰。

requirementsZh: 说明申请意向
列举至少两条自身优势
写明希望承担的工作
openingSentences: I'm writing to apply for the position of volunteer at the International Culture Festival.
items.modelAnswer:
Dear Ms. Brown,

I'm Li Hua, a student from Class 3, Senior Two. I'm writing to apply for the position of volunteer at the International Culture Festival next month.

I believe I am suitable for the job. First, I can speak English fluently, so I can communicate with foreign guests without difficulty. Second, I took part in last year's festival as a guide, which gave me useful experience. Besides, I am patient and enjoy working with others.

If accepted, I would like to help at the reception desk and show guests around the campus. I'm looking forward to your reply.

Yours,
Li Hua

items.promptZh: 你校英文报正在以 “An Unforgettable Volunteer Activity” 为题征稿。假定你是李华，请写一篇短文投稿，内容包括：(1)活动的时间与内容；(2)活动中印象深刻的经历；(3)你的收获与感受。注意：写作词数应为 80-120 词。

explanation.summaryZh: 记叙类投稿按时间顺序交代活动与细节，结尾升华感受。
explanation.ruleZh: 投稿类应用文叙事中穿插感受，结尾点题升华，避免只罗列流水账。

requirementsZh: 包含标题 An Unforgettable Volunteer Activity
交代活动时间与内容
描写一次印象深刻的经历
openingSentences: Last Saturday, five classmates and I visited the Sunshine Nursing Home.
items.modelAnswer:
An Unforgettable Volunteer Activity

Last Saturday, five classmates and I visited the Sunshine Nursing Home to spend the day with the elderly there.

After cleaning the windows and the yard, we put on a short performance of songs and comedy. What impressed me most was Grandpa Zhang, a retired English teacher. He corrected my pronunciation patiently when I read him a poem, and told me stories about his students decades ago. Time passed quickly, and none of us wanted to leave.

This activity taught me that a little of our time can bring great warmth to others. Volunteering, I believe, should become a habit rather than a one-time event.

items.promptZh: 读后续写：学校运动会上，你参加 1500 米赛跑并一路领先。最后一圈时，你的好友兼对手林强突然摔倒在地，你停下了脚步。请根据所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一篇完整的短文。注意：(1)续写词数应为 150-180 词；(2)请按所给格式分段作答。

explanation.summaryZh: 续写接住摔倒与助人的情节，第二段写赛后的意外反转，主题落在体育精神。
explanation.ruleZh: 读后续写先呼应所给首句，再用动作、对话推进情节，结尾点明主题并与前文呼应。

requirementsZh: 紧扣两段所给开头语续写
情节合理，与前文摔倒助人衔接
使用动作、对话等细节描写
openingSentences: When the race ended, something unexpected happened.
items.modelAnswer:
I stopped and turned around. Lin Qiang was lying on the track, holding his ankle in pain. For a second, the finish line flashed through my mind, but I ran back and helped him up. 'Can you walk?' I asked. He shook his head, so I put his arm over my shoulder and we moved forward slowly, step by step. The cheers around us grew louder and louder, and some students ran alongside us, calling out our names.

When the race ended, something unexpected happened. We crossed the line last, but the whole stadium stood up and clapped for us. Even the runners who had finished earlier came back to cheer. The headmaster announced that we had won a special prize for sportsmanship, which had never been given before. Lin Qiang hugged me and said, 'You gave up the gold medal for me.' I smiled and shook my head. True victory, I have learned, is not always about being the first one to cross the finish line.

items.promptZh: 读后续写：为给山区学校购买图书，你们班筹备了一个月的爱心义卖共筹得 2,300 元。周五放学清点时，装钱的铁盒不见了，大家又急又疑。请根据所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一篇完整的短文。注意：(1)续写词数应为 150-180 词；(2)请按所给格式分段作答。

explanation.summaryZh: 续写揭示钱盒失而复得的真相，第二段用一封短信完成从怀疑到信任的主题升华。
explanation.ruleZh: 续写第二段要解决第一段留下的悬念，情感变化要有具体细节支撑。

requirementsZh: 紧扣两段所给开头语续写
解释钱盒下落并完成情感反转
结尾呼应爱心义卖的初衷
openingSentences: Just then, our teacher Ms. Gao walked in with a smile.
The next morning, a small envelope appeared on my desk.
items.modelAnswer:
Just then, our teacher Ms. Gao walked in with a smile. In her hand was the very tin box we had been searching for. 'Someone took it to the office by mistake this afternoon,' she explained, holding it up for everyone to see. Cheers broke out in the classroom, and the boy who had been blamed burst into tears of relief. Ms. Gao opened the box and counted the money with us again. All 2,300 yuan was there, safe and sound.

The next morning, a small envelope appeared on my desk. Inside was a note written in pencil: 'I'm sorry I doubted my classmates. Here is a book for the mountain school, from a boy who has learned to trust.' I recognized the handwriting at once. Without telling anyone, I quietly placed the envelope into the donation box. When our books finally reached the mountain school, I believe the story of that envelope would matter as much as the money.

items.promptZh: 读后续写：市英语演讲比赛前夜，你紧张得难以入睡。清晨，爷爷把一支他用了一辈子的旧钢笔放进你的口袋，说：“笔会记得你写下的每一个字，你也要相信你说出的每一个字。”到了赛场，轮到你上台时……请根据所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一篇完整的短文。注意：(1)续写词数应为 150-180 词；(2)请按所给格式分段作答。

explanation.summaryZh: 续写从大脑空白到钢笔带来的镇定，以勇气与自信收束，呼应爷爷的话。
explanation.ruleZh: 续写要激活材料中的关键道具（钢笔）与人物话语，形成情节闭环，心理变化要有层次。

requirementsZh: 紧扣两段所给开头语续写
写出由紧张到自信的心理变化
呼应爷爷赠笔的细节与话语
openingSentences: As I walked onto the stage, my mind suddenly went blank.
Then my fingers touched something hard in my pocket.
items.modelAnswer:
As I walked onto the stage, my mind suddenly went blank. Hundreds of eyes were fixed on me, and the speech I had practised a hundred times seemed to disappear. My hands trembled, my voice stuck somewhere in my throat, and for a long moment the hall was completely silent. I could feel my heart beating wildly, as if it were trying to escape.

Then my fingers touched something hard in my pocket. It was Grandpa's old pen, warm as if it had just left his hand. His words came back to me: believe in every word you speak. I took a deep breath and began, slowly at first, then more steadily. Sentence by sentence, my voice grew stronger, and the audience began to nod. When I finished, applause filled the hall. I did not win the first prize that day, but I brought home something greater: the courage to stand up and speak. Grandpa's pen now lies on my desk, reminding me that confidence often hides in the smallest things.
